node.statement: The primal optimum h in nodes 1.4.1 and 1.4.2 was arbitrary, while the reduced optimal witness (lambda,alpha,beta) was fixed. Hence every f with lambda_f>0 satisfies h(p_f)=t for every primal optimum h, every i with alpha_i>0 satisfies h(p_i)=0 for every primal optimum h, and every i with beta_i>0 satisfies h(p_i)=1 for every primal optimum h. By node 1.1.2, these are exactly membership in the always-tight families T, Z, and O respectively; therefore supp(lambda) is contained in T, supp(alpha) is contained in Z, and supp(beta) is contained in O.
